entities.name: Sigarda
aliases: Sigarda the Hope of the Lost
entities.description: Archangel of Innistrad associated with purity and birth, leader of the Flight of Herons.

entities.name: Liesa
entities.description: Sigarda's sister whose death left Sigarda resentful of Avacyn.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Archangel who became corrupted and advocated genocide of humans.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Planeswalker and vampire who fights Sigarda.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Cathar who fought alongside Sigarda at Thraben.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's grandfather, whose powers Olivia needed.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: Spirit in the Moonsilver Key who freed Sigarda.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: Artifact controlling the balance of night and day.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Planeswalker group that helped recover the Key.

entities.name: Battle of Thraben
entities.description: Battle where Sigarda fought the corrupted angels.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion Sigarda helped defend Innistrad against.

events.summary: Avacyn, fully corrupted, confronts Sigarda and threatens her; Sigarda vows to fight the archangel.
events.quote: Sigarda cried and vowed to fight the archangel.

events.summary: At the Battle of Thraben Sigarda fights the corrupted angels with Thalia.
events.quote: aiding the Cathar Thalia in slaying the monstrosity that was comprised of her former sisters

events.summary: Sigarda appears and stops Sorin's sword attack, telling Arlinn's group where the Key is while she battles him.
events.quote: The second time, Sigarda appears and stops Sorin's sword attack.

events.summary: Olivia captures and imprisons Sigarda after her fight with Sorin.
events.quote: After fighting Sorin, she was captured and imprisoned by Olivia Voldaren

events.summary: Katilda frees Sigarda, whose angelic burst shatters the wedding hall's windows.
events.quote: Upon being released Sigarda exploded her angelic aura in fury

events.summary: Sigarda defends Innistrad in the New Phyrexian Invasion and channels Halo.
events.quote: Sigarda fought to defend Innistrad during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
